title: Instacart and OpenAI partner on AI shopping experiences
summary: OpenAI and Instacart are deepening their longstanding partnership by bringing the first fully integrated grocery shopping and Instant Checkout payment app to ChatGPT.
body: OpenAI and Instacart are deepening their longstanding partnership by bringing the first fully integrated grocery shopping and Instant Checkout payment app to ChatGPT.
summaryZh: Instacart与OpenAI深化合作，将购物与支付功能直接集成至ChatGPT中。用户可通过ChatGPT完成从选购到结账的完整流程，体现了AI助手向垂直领域服务深度渗透的趋势。

aiReview.reasonZh: Instacart与OpenAI的深度集成展示了AI在零售电商场景下的功能扩展与用户体验创新。
